text:
miles: quick idea: regional edge gateway that can accept encrypted 'escrow' intents when global lease is unreachable. looking for ops and security check.

anya: interesting. preserve residency by keeping escrow local?

miles: yes. escrow stays in-region, envelope-encrypted with tenant KMS. only metadata (not payload) is sent to central audit.

kevin: how do we avoid split-brain?

miles: lease-first. only if lease-check times out after N ms and tenant policy allows degraded_writes do we write to escrow. each intent includes tenant-epoch + monotonic seq. reconcilers replay by seq. non-idempotent conflicts flagged.

ops-bot: created preview deploy edge-gateway/escrow-canary -> https://deploys.internal/edge-gateway/escrow-canary

anya: add metric `escrow.accepted` and tenant report. legal tenants must be able to set allow_degraded=false.

miles: noted. I'll draft minimal RFC with dataflow, reconcile pseudo, and test cases. will ping for review.
